digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, reducer, manifest parsing, signing transaction
propositions: Plan-review attestations must distinguish planning and execution phases with phase metadata embedded in compiled state and manifest signatures.
Execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor blocking policy, while planning-phase reviews retain stricter thresholds.

Reducer maintains plan_review_phase lifecycle projection from STATUS target (in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve) with snapshot compaction and pre-feature bootstrap from compiled status.

Manifest and sidecar serialize phase/floor as structured tokens (review-phase and priority-floor lines) and v2 JSON (lowercase phase string, numeric floor or omitted), rejecting malformed or incompatible variants through validation helpers.

Signing transaction captures immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM/probe, retries up to three times on HEAD instability, and atomically verifies generation and HEAD under write lock before committing; any mismatch or terminal error leaves no partial state.

Phase compatibility enforces planning+planning/legacy=compatible, planning+execution=incompatible, execution+planning/legacy=compatible, execution+execution(floor≥0.80)=compatible, and malformed/floor<0.80=incompatible/malformed on every validity consumer (claim, reuse, drift, re-sign, child gates).
